title: Treaty of Madrid (1526)
summary: Wikidata item Q1322711, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "treaty adopted in 1526 by which the French king renounced claims in Italy, surrendered Burgundy to Spain, and abandoned sovereignty over Flanders and Artois". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
